final: WITH genre_counts AS (SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) as genre_count FROM film_category fc JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(genre_count) as total FROM genre_counts), genre_shares AS (SELECT gc.genre_count, CAST(gc.genre_count AS FLOAT) / tc.total as share FROM genre_counts gc CROSS JOIN total_count tc), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_val FROM genre_shares), above_avg AS (SELECT genre_count, share FROM genre_shares CROSS JOIN avg_share WHERE share > avg_share.avg_share_val) SELECT AVG(genre_count) as avg_genre_count, AVG(share) as avg_genre_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share_val FROM avg_share)) as avg_difference FROM above_avg
